paragraphs: The Nasdaq enters the pre-market with a strong negative setup: the Nasdaq Score is -52/100. Consolidation Risk is 23/100 (Low).

Nasdaq internals are mixed, so directional confirmation is incomplete (semiconductors negative, mega-caps mixed, breadth mixed).
